videos.title: Love Is In The Air! 1970-1979
videos.description: Three hours of up-tempo feel-good songs about love - spanning the whole decade! Get your dancin' shoes on with The Jacksons, Abba, Elton, Anita Ward and John Paul Young.

videos.title: Pat Sharp's Surely Not A Cover?
videos.description: In year order - Pat's list of 30 classic 70s anthems that were all covers. Including Rod Stewart, The Clash, Manfred Mann, John Lennon, Shirley Bassey & The Wurzels.

videos.title: Magic Moments! The 70s
videos.description: Experience the magic of the 70s, where every beat was a spell and every song a timeless enchantment.

videos.title: Derek Griffiths: Playschool Disco!
videos.description: The voice of your childhood Derek Griffiths with 40 of those tunes you pestered your parents to buy - all top pop moments that still bring a smile & happy memories of school days.

videos.title: Magic Moments! The 70s
videos.description: Experience the magic of the 70s, where every beat was a spell and every song a timeless enchantment.

videos.title: Is This Really How They Started?!
videos.description: Most went on to bigger things - but how did it all start in the 70s? Here are 30 chart and video debuts from household names - some songs are brilliant, but some you might not know.

videos.title: Saturday Night's Alright!
videos.description: From the era of glam rock, new wave and disco, it's all the party hits from just one decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready.

videos.title: Sally James' Girls On Top!
videos.description: Back in the day, being a woman in a macho world of pop meant you had to fight so much harder! So let's celebrate with those who made their mark - from Annie & Elkie to Kim & Kate.

videos.title: Saturday Night's Alright!
videos.description: From the era of glam rock, new wave and disco, it's all the party hits from just one decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready.

videos.title: 40 Songs That Make You Smile!
videos.description: Another 40 feelgood songs guaranteed to bring a smile - one way or another! Expect a bit of rock, a bit of pop, a bit of love and a good slice of cheese.

videos.title: Saturday Night's Alright!
videos.description: From the era of glam rock, new wave and disco, it's all the party hits from just one decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready.

videos.title: Limahl's Never Ending Soundtracks!
videos.description: 2 decades of movie moments and classic pop hits from the 70s & 80s. Direct from the red carpet - Limahl is ready for his close-up.

videos.title: I'm Stone In Love With You!
videos.description: Crackling vinyl, shag carpets & lava lamp glows - this is how we loved in the 70s! Oh James..

videos.title: Morning Has Broken!
videos.description: From the era of glam rock, new wave and disco, it's all the hits from just one decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready.

videos.title: It Could Only Happen In The 70s!
videos.description: Dodgy dancing, slightly inappropriate flirting, extreme close-ups, chest hair, huge afros and those crazy fashions! 25 songs and videos that could only have been made in the 1970s.

videos.title: 1973 Unleashed!
videos.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1973.

videos.title: Tony Blackburn's 70s Glam Pop!
videos.description: Big singalong choruses and outrageous outfits & make-up - these were the guys & gals that set the style of the 70s - and our man with the musical plan Tony Blackburn was there.

videos.title: 1973 Unleashed!
videos.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1973.

videos.title: Groovy Little Numbers! Top 25
videos.description: Twenty-five laid-back songs from the first half of the decade - expect long hair, trippy vibes and a few leftover hippies from the 60s.

videos.title: Derek Griffiths' Cartoon Xmas!
videos.description: The voice of your childhood with 30 festive faves especially animated for Christmas! Including Brenda Lee, Beach Boys, Michael Buble, Elvis Presley & The Frog Chorus.

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready.

videos.title: Who Won Wot in 1970?
videos.description: Mark Goodier with 1970's big music award winners. At the start of the decade which superstar singer won at the Oscars, and who got the keys to the City of Indiana.

videos.title: 1970 Unleashed!
videos.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1970.

videos.title: The Best 1970 Party...Ever!
videos.description: Blimey, what a year! Get ready to turn your telly up LOUD, with the greatest party anthems from 1970 including The Jackson Five, Mungo Jerry, Black Sabbath, Free & Elvis Presley.

videos.title: Rosko's Hellraisers! Top 25
videos.description: The biggest rock n roll rebels of the 1970s, presented by the man who was there - that groovy host from the west coast - Radio 1 legend Rosko.

videos.title: 1970 Unleashed!
videos.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1970.

videos.title: Essentials! 70s Rock Groups
videos.description: Turn it up loud for 2 hours of proper rock from the 70s - the decade that gave birth to Prog and Metal! Including Pink Floyd, Led Zeppelin, Black Sabbath, Alice Cooper, AC/DC and Queen.

videos.title: NOW 70s presents NOW 60s!
videos.description: 5 hours of flashbacks from the swinging 60s! Including Johnny Cash, Sam Cooke, The Kinks, Lulu, The Beach Boys, The Beatles, The Troggs, Bob Dylan, The Rolling Stones & Elvis.

videos.title: Back To The 60s!
videos.description: We're grooving back to the swinging 60s for classic videos, legendary artists & enough flower power to upset your local florist.

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready.

videos.title: Bruno Brookes-Never Even A Top 10?
videos.description: Bruno Brookes guides you through the stats in disbelief! Three hours of top tunes from superstars like Bowie, Abba, Bob Marley, Queen, The Who and more. But why didn't we buy 'em?

videos.title: Retro Rewind! 70s Edition
videos.description: From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s.

videos.title: What? They Only Peaked at 11?
videos.description: That's right - every one of these (mostly) classic tunes JUST missed the UK top 10. All of them got to number 11 and no higher! Including Simply Red, Cher, Bryan Adams and The Clash.

videos.title: Disco Fever!
videos.description: Get on the Love Train with some top tunes to satisfy those Boogie Nights.

videos.title: Disco Bling! Top 25
videos.description: 25 of the campest & glitziest disco videos known to man. Sunglasses at the ready 'cause you'll be blinded by the bright lights & brilliant bling.

videos.title: Disco Battle! Boney M vs ABBA
videos.description: Get on the dancefloor and see who has the biggest 70s disco beats - Boney M or ABBA.

videos.title: Tony's Sensational 70s Xmas!
videos.description: Tinsel Tony Blackburn with tons of terrific tunes & festive fun for Christmas - all from the 1970s.

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready.

videos.title: Festive Faves! 70s v 60s v 50s
videos.description: 3 decades of classic festive faves from Bing Crosby & Perry Como to Boney M & Paul McCartney.

videos.title: Clare Grogan's Teenage Kicks!
videos.description: The 5 years from '77 to '81 was possibly the most exciting & vibrant time to be a teenager & Clare Grogan was there - buying the records, seeing the bands & wearing the t-shirts.

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971.

videos.title: Michael & The Jacksons!
videos.description: 6 mega party hits & 3 ballads from the Jackson family - in order.

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971.

videos.title: Every Number 2 of 1971
videos.description: Runners-up from the UK charts in 1971 - 12 songs that didn't quite make it. Starting & ending with T.Rex, we keep up the class with Bridget The Midget & Tweedle Dum Tweedle Dee.

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971.

videos.title: American No.1s of 1971
videos.description: In order - 10 videos that hit the top of the US chart in 1971. Some are obvious, but there are a few surprises along the way.

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971.
